newsitem.title: PERU: Peru tax revenues rise 0.4 pct in Nov vs year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru tax revenues rise 0.4 pct in Nov vs year-ago.

text.p: Peru's tax revenues rose in November to 1.613 billion soles, 0.4 percent higher in inflation-adjusted terms than the same month last year, the National Superintendency of Tax Administration (SUNAT) said Monday.
The SUNAT added accumulated revenues for the first ten months of 1996 were 18.094 billion soles, up 5.7 percent compared with the same period last year after taking into account inflation.
Tax collection last year rose 27.7 percent nominally to 17.063 billion soles, from 13.363 billion soles in 1994.
Peru's cumulative consumer inflation in the last 12 months of 1996 was 11.9 percent.
